answer.headline: Average order value dropped due to a shift in basket composition among new users.
explanation: Average order value saw a shift compared to the prior week as new visitors bought lower-priced items or smaller quantities.
The new user segment diverged from the rest of the site starting from Tue 15 Dec 2020, accounting for a large portion of the decline.
While overall week-over-week variation remained within typical ranges, this specific segment's basket value dropped significantly.
answer.next_step: Investigate merchandising and promotional paths targeting new visitors to see why cart composition changed.
